nodes.label: Core-core term dcc at row 56 (ent 6s, run 5d)
nodes.rationale: Filed positive (widens) with |dcc| < 0.08 Ha and no bound-direction claimed; the own-slot pieces live on the RUN side only because 6s is closed on the ent side.

nodes.label: The (1-f) slot rule
nodes.rationale: Fractional slot availability (1-f) replaces a hard exclusion rule for open shells; the decisive evidence is the consistency can-fail on an untouched pair, which should agree to 15% under (1-f) and fail badly under exclusion.

nodes.label: Untouched-pair consistency can-fail (5p-5p within 15%)
nodes.rationale: A pair no open slot touches must come out the same on the ent_w and core sides; it is the internal control that the partition removed only what it claimed to remove.
